messages:
Alex Wu: opening a small tidy PR to refresh the Quickstart 'Hello' flow. Primary goals: make auth CLI-first (`redwood login`), keep a short CI env example, tighten the minimal deploy to one copy-paste command (k8s and docker variants), fix a broken /learn link, and add a short migration note for the model alias rename. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5077
Marco Silva: +1 to CLI-first. Can we include a Windows PowerShell example for setting the env var? Lots of folks on Windows get tripped. Something like: `$env:REDWOOD_API_KEY = "<KEY>"`
Alex Wu: good call  will add PowerShell and a GitHub Actions snippet under an "Advanced / CI" collapsible. Top of page will show `redwood login --api-key <KEY>` for copy/paste.
Lina Gomez: heads up
bout wording on limits: previous quickstart said "no rate limits" which is misleading. Please change to "soft limits apply on free tier; see pricing" and link to pricing.
Priya (Docs): Also add a one-line tip about key scoping (user vs org keys) and a tiny troubleshooting curl command for auth checks, e.g.: `curl -I -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/health` and note common causes of 401 (wrong key & clock skew).
Alex Wu: added the token-scope note + curl check. Also included a short macOS-safe migration helper for the model rename (`helium-v1` -> `helium`): two options: `git grep -l "helium-v1" | xargs sed -i '' 's/helium-v1/helium/g'` (mac) and `git grep -l "helium-v1" | xargs sed -i 's/helium-v1/helium/g'` (linux).
Marco Silva: for Docker base please use `node:18-bullseye-slim` in the primary example and provide an Alpine variant in a note. Some enterprise customers prefer debian-slim base images.
Alex Wu: switched to `node:18-bullseye-slim` and appended an alpine snippet. Also added a short K8s single-line deploy: `kubectl run hello --image=redwood/hello:latest --env="REDWOOD_API_KEY=$REDWOOD_API_KEY" --restart=Never` with a note that it's for demo only.
Priya (Docs): UX nit: collapse the migration helpers and advanced env bits by default so new users see only the minimal path. Keep the PowerShell example visible though (common OS blocker).
Alex Wu: done  advanced items collapsed, PowerShell and GitHub Actions snippet still inline. Also updated the example client init to show an EU region variant: `RedwoodClient(region="eu-west-1")`.
build-bot: Preview build queued for PR 5077  (staging preview soon: https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/quickstart-hello/preview)
Lina Gomez: quick legal ask: add the "demo only" badge near the kubectl and docker run lines so folks don't assume production readiness.
Alex Wu: added "DEMO ONLY" label and a short pointer to the Dedicated docs for production deployment patterns. Pushed final changes.
build-bot: Preview build succeeded for PR 5077  (staging preview: https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/quickstart-hello/preview)
Priya (Docs): Reviewed and left two tiny style nits (heading depth + an inline link resolver). Once those are fixed I'm happy to approve.
Alex Wu: fixed the nits and merged after scheduled docs deploy window. Thanks everyone! :tada:
